reference.cwd_note: run with a temp cwd holding pyproject.toml and a stand-in client_v2/build/200.html

ignored_headers.date: volatile: the time of the answer
ignored_headers.server: set by the HTTP server (uvicorn), not by Spoolman's code

normalisation.now: a string that parses as an ISO 8601 date-time (`T` or space between date and time) within 300 s of the time the request was made becomes `<now>`; any other date-time stays as it is (the requests use fixed dates in 2024)
normalisation.paths: in /info, `data_dir`, `logs_dir`, `backups_dir` become `<path>` (a temp dir); `latest_version` and `update_available` become `<volatile>` (Spoolman asks GitHub), and so does its `content-length`, which follows from them; in /backup, `path` becomes `<path>`
normalisation.json: JSON bodies are compared as values and by key order: of the keys two objects both have, the order must be the same (Spoolman writes its models' field order; the hub keeps the order it inserts, `preserve_order`, chosen in the hub's own `Cargo.toml` so the order does not depend on what else is in the build)
normalisation.text: other bodies (CSV) are compared as text after the date-time rule
